notes: Prototype only, not connected to the production solver.
One full F+B per batch; local Linear candidate matmuls still scale with candidates.
Optional shared variant uses R=G.T@Q8(X) once per Linear/batch and scans candidate delta-W; it reuses independent branch input gradients for delta-X.
Shared variant keeps delta-X/delta-W cross terms, omits candidate output BF16 rounding, and does not compute or fabricate per-token RMS.
Baseline boundary input/output references stay live until their backward hook.
Parameter .grad buffers stay empty; shared R is a temporary gradient-like chunk. No candidate full-model/backward/block replays are computed.
The first-order signed score can be negative; clipping creates ties.
abs(mean)+RMS is diagnostic, without a fitted mixing coefficient.
3 fixed seeds, optional tiny fitting uses calibration texts; no pretrained LLM claim.
One warmup dataset pass per model and full-plan checks are outside analysis timing.
